subtasks.title: Split words on runs of whitespace
subtasks.description: In words.js, countWords() uses text.split(" "), so repeated, leading or trailing whitespace yields empty strings that are counted, and '' counts as one word. Split the trimmed text on /\s+/ and return 0 for blank text.

input.new:
const trimmed = text.trim();
  return trimmed === "" ? 0 : trimmed.split(/\s+/).length;

input.summary: countWords splits the trimmed text on whitespace runs; blank text has 0 words.

input.feedback: Handles runs of whitespace and blank input.
